component.title: Resize Observer
component.purpose: Observed border-box geometry for a ref-attached element.

states.description: The observer is owned by an effect keyed on the attached node.

claims.statement: The observer is created and disconnected in an effect, not in a callback ref, because React 18 discards a cleanup returned from a callback ref.
The reported rect is the border box, matching what a caller clamping against a container measures.
